scope: Dated, sanitized one-time Coinbase permissions and portfolio metadata observation only.
result: Two HTTP200 metadata receipts; view/trade true, transfer false, one DEFAULT portfolio matching the assigned key hash.
limits: Execution and endpoint responses are capture-attested, not independently replayed.
One visible portfolio does not establish whole-account coverage.
No balances, spendability, paging or trading qualification.
Outer child deadline used; initial/final local work and native Popen are not interruptibly timed.
